description_en: Modifies the VPC, private IP address, security group, or vSwitch of a VPC-type ECS instance
description_zh: 修改一台专有网络类型ECS实例的专有网络VPC、私网IP地址、安全组或交换机
kebab_example: aliyun ecs modify-instance-vpc-attribute --instance-id i-bp1iudwa5b1tqag10000 --vswitch-id vsw-bp1s5fnvk4gn3tw120000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyInstanceVpcAttribute

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

When you call this operation, the ECS instance must be in the Stopped (`Stopped`) state. For other restrictions on the instance, read the Operation description section carefully
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

调用该接口时，ECS实例的状态必须是已停止（`Stopped`），其他对于实例的限制条件，请认真阅读接口说明部分
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The vSwitch ID.

If the specified ID is the current vSwitch of the instance, the vSwitch of the instance remains unchanged.
If the specified ID is a new vSwitch and the VpcId parameter is not specified, the new and original vSwitches must belong to the same zone and the same VPC.
If the VpcId parameter is specified, the vSwitch ID specified in this parameter must belong to the VpcId and must be in the same zone as the original vSwitch
parameters.help_zh:
交换机ID。

传入的ID为实例的当前交换机时，表明实例不变更交换机。
传入的ID为一台新的交换机，并且参数`VpcId`为空时，新旧交换机必须属于同一个可用区、同一个专有网络VPC。
当参数`VpcId`不为空时，该参数传入的交换机ID必须属于VpcId，并且和原交换机属于同一个可用区
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en:
The new private IP address.

The PrivateIpAddress parameter depends on VSwitchId. The specified IP address must be within the CIDR block of the vSwitch.

Default value: If this parameter is not specified, an IP address is randomly assigned from the CIDR block of the vSwitch
parameters.help_zh:
新的私网IP地址。

参数`PrivateIpAddress`依赖于`VSwitchId`，指定的IP地址必须在虚拟交换机子网网段中。

默认值：当不传该值时，从虚拟交换机子网网段中随机分配
parameters.name: private_ip_address

parameters.help_en:
The list of security group IDs that the instance joins after the VPC is modified. This parameter is required only when the VpcId parameter is specified.

The VPC of the security group must match the target VPC.
Specifies the list of security groups that the instance joins after the modification. You can specify one or more security groups. The number of security groups is subject to the limit on the number of security groups that an instance can join. For more information, see [Limits](~~25412#SecurityGroupQuota1~~).
All security groups in the list must be of the same type.
Switching between security group types is supported.
          When an ECS instance switches between security group types, make sure that you understand the differences in the security group rule configurations of the two security group types to avoid affecting the instance network. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25387.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例修改VPC后加入的安全组ID列表。当且仅当传入`VpcId`参数时，需要同时传入该参数。

安全组所属的VPC必须与目标VPC一致。
指定修改后实例加入的安全组列表，可以是一个或者多个。安全组个数与实例能够加入安全组的限制有关。具体限制，请参见[使用限制](~~25412#SecurityGroupQuota1~~)。
列表内安全组类型必须一致。
支持切换安全组的类型。
          当ECS实例跨类型切换安全组时，您需要充分了解两种安全组规则的配置区别，避免影响实例网络。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25387.html
parameters.name: security_group_id
